scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,api,web "npm run dev --workspace @solar-management/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @solar-management/server" "npm run dev --workspace @solar-management/client"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @solar-management/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @solar-management/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @solar-management/server && npm run build --workspace @solar-management/client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate --workspace @solar-management/server
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run db:seed --workspace @solar-management/server
scripts.simulate: npm run build:shared && npm run simulate --workspace @solar-management/server
